The '''Gannaria system''' was located in the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was notable for the production of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was the origin point of the [[Gannarian narco-spice]] variant.<ref name="SW52">[[Star Wars (1977) 52|''Star Wars'' (1977) 52]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Gannarian narco-spice]]|system=Gannaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Gannaria system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI" /> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited the Gannaria system on a mission for a member of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at some point between [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The population of the system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered less than one million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gannaria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square H-15.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
